item.text: *Monstera acuminata*, or shingle plant, is an aroid native from Mexico through Central America. Juveniles creep along the ground with overlapping, waxy, heart-shaped leaves, then climb tree trunks using anchoring roots. Mature plants develop larger leaves resembling those of *Monstera deliciosa*; the stem eventually loses its connection to the soil. [s1:p1–p3]
